Good to know

Questions

Does a customer need to install an app?No. The QR opens a web page; no login is needed.
Can each table have its own QR?Yes. Each QR carries its table ID, such as ?table=T01.
Can menus change by time?Yes. Breakfast, lunch, snacks and dinner schedules are editable.
Can customers get bills on WhatsApp?Yes. The demo opens a prefilled WhatsApp chat; delivery needs a real integration.
Multiple branches or kitchen staff?The data model is built to extend to both when a backend is connected.
